title: Many users at one site cannot work
owner: Synthetic evaluation fixture (test-only; not CDIT policy)

sections.heading: Several users at one site cannot open the same feature
sections.text: When many users at one site cannot open the same feature, treat the report as a possible service outage. Staff collect the details below and hand the report to an Admin for human review. Staff do not run single-user troubleshooting steps or promise a fix time. Urgency is decided in human Auditor review.

steps.text: Record the site, the feature that will not open, how many users are affected, when it started, and the exact error message, without patient or subject details.

information_needed.prompt: Synthetic site identifier where users are affected.
The feature or screen that will not open.
How many users are affected, as reported.
When the problem started, as reported.

stop_conditions.text: Hand the report to an Admin for human review. Do not handle it as a routine single-user request.
